svg.title: What the pipeline did to the real CMS files
svg.desc: 2,936,994 rows read. 2,264,443 were weekly repeats and 207 were rejected, leaving 672,344 price changes. A 12-drug subset keeps 68,471 changes in 222 groups.
svg.text: weekly repeats of a rate we already have
207 rejected: effective date later than its own publication date
CMS publishes every rate every week. only the first time we see a
demo subset of 12 common drugs: 68,471 changes · 222 groups · 3,435 NDCs
